subject: Learning Methods
title: Breaking Bad Study Habits
description: A short lesson to help you apply Breaking Bad Study Habits.

hook.text: He checked his phone 150 times a day. Each check reset his focus timer. His study sessions were 3 minutes on average.

buildup.text: Bad habits are hard to break because the neural pathways persist. You can't erase a habit. You must replace it.

discovery.text: Identify the cue triggering the bad habit. Then design a replacement routine that satisfies the same reward through.

twist.text: Friction works both ways. Making the bad habit harder to perform is as effective as making the good one easier.

climax.text: Put your phone in a drawer during study. Add friction to distractions. Remove friction from learning tools.

punchline.text: Add friction to distractions. Remove it from learning.

quiz.question: What is the most effective way to break a bad study habit?
options: Use willpower to resist the urge each time
Replace the routine with a better one that uses the same cue and reward
Punish yourself each time you engage in the bad habit
